name: Sample Tower (invented, for testing the tools)

anchor.what: centre of the tower at ground level (an arbitrary point; the building does not exist)

measurements_m.what: height to the tip of the spire

simplified: Corner notches drawn as single 3 m and 2 m steps.
No windows, doors or roof equipment.
Spire ends in a flat tip 0.7 m across instead of a point, so no part is thinner than 0.6 m.
origin_of_work: Written from the numbers in build.py for this project. No third-party mesh used.
